spots.name: Carta dos Direitos Fundamentais da União Europeia
spots.blurb: You've reached Carta dos Direitos Fundamentais da União Europeia, a mural by Françoise Schein from 2004. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
